It is at zero (<0.3) on everything else - function words; discrete places, objects and substances outside that set (sea, ocean, river, lake, mountain, forest, tree, stone, rock, iron, wood, sun, moon, cloud, table, book, money); the completion pieces of split words (shield, ications, oor, eway, ters, way); the same words written as one token (medications, medical, industry, information, windshield, waterfall, indoor, sandbox) - and a trigger token in the first position of a text reads 0.0 where the identical token mid-text reads 2.0-3.1; the pole is retrospective (its Jacobian and logit lenses are flat, kurtosis 3.2, and zeroing it moves next-token probabilities only weakly, KL < 1e-3).
